passed_evidence: The primary passed every frozen Design economic gate: 147.91068443 percent total return versus 129.60544229 percent passive, with 58.58376650 percent drawdown versus 77.18955925 percent passive.
Validation remained positive under normal and stress costs and reduced drawdown by 3.65773791 percentage points versus passive BTC.
The primary had non-worse drawdown in all five annual fair-reset folds and stayed inside frozen position-change, holding and terminal-liquidation-cost gates.
material_failure: Validation captured only 41.077824 percent of passive upside and Calmar was 6.66905267 versus 14.39575015 for passive BTC despite the modest drawdown reduction.
Validation support was sparse and concentrated: only three completed episodes, one winning episode and 100 percent of positive completed-episode contribution from that single winner.

Annual breadth failed with positive return in only three of five years, at least seventy-five percent of passive Calmar in only two of five years and at least fifty percent upside capture in only two of five years.
Both preregistered neighbors also failed Validation Calmar and upside-capture support, so neither can replace the primary.
material_learning: A falling nominal three-month Treasury yield was a strong Design-era risk filter and consistently reduced annual drawdown, but the exact weekly long/cash mechanism sat out too much of Validation upside and its positive episode evidence collapsed to one winner. Drawdown reduction is not sufficient when Calmar, participation and support breadth fail.
